strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Nadesico Y Unit destroyed
So boring...
We're due at the rendezvous with the Elshank in a few hours.
Finally meeting up, huh... Let's join up fast and get back to the ruins.
That decision... we'll leave to Londo Bell's commander.
This is no time to be so laid-back...
Abnormal surge in boson particle readings in the aft hangar.
Huh...?
Eek!
Enemy ship detected at the edge of sensor range.
It's heading straight for the Nadesico.
Boson reaction, this time at the tip of the Y Unit...
Wha-wha-whaaat!? What the heck was that explosion!?
If not for the distortion blocks, we'd all be goners by now...
Distortion blocks... Come to think of it, how do those work?
So glad you asked!
It's a system that seals off damaged sections of the ship
with a Distortion Field. Heh heh heh heh heh...
Never mind how it works. Shouldn't we figure out why it exploded first?
What's the enemy's status!?
Distance 42 km. Visual contact soon.
What shall we do, Captain?
Let's run. ...Minato, full acceleration away from the enemy, please.
Sure, but that'll take us a bit away from the rendezvous point, y'know.
That's fine!
Okay, okay.
Boson reaction, this time directly below the bridge...
Full throttle!
Nadesico, rapid retreat!
We found fragments of an explosive in the damaged block's wreckage.
...The material closely matches the Jovian forces' shell warheads...
In short, there's a good chance they're the same thing.
A bomb? So it wasn't an attack from outside?
Allow me to explain!
Y-You're sure fired up.
Well, naturally.
...Now then, everyone. The big robots the Jovian forces deployed lately...
I trust you remember them well. Now, gather round!
These robots are powerful weapons with built-in phase transition engines,
but that's not even the most frightening part!
They can perform a Boson Jump without the aid of a Tulip...
So if a robot can teleport without using a Tulip...
Bombs, missiles, whatever... they can send anything right to us...!
Exactly. The enemy teleported explosives right into the Nadesico...
And we have absolutely no way to defend against it.
...Boson Cannon...
Boson Cannon?
Oh, um, I just figured it needs a name, or it won't feel right~
Boson of a gun... Ohhh~
...S-So anyway, how are we supposed to deal with it!
Then again, there's nothing we can do... huh...
Enemy entering effective radar range.
Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!
Running off right away! Typical gutless Earthlings!!
They must be terrified of our Leap Cannon.
Naive... Their quick decision is why our third Leap Cannon shot missed.
Don't underestimate the enemy captain.
Aren't you overrating them?
Well, as they say... a lion enters the tiger's den even to catch a rabbit!
Keep the Denjin ready to launch at any time!
Roger!!
We don't have time for this...!
Humans fighting humans... What are we doing...!
...Human...! That's right, the Jovian Alliance people are... human too...!
Minato! Please stop the engines!
What!?
...Minovsky particles ready for dispersal, Captain.
When did you... load something like that?
You read my mind! Ruri!
The Aestivalis team seems ready to launch... What should we do?
Launch immediately, pleeease!
Akito! Do your best!
Hey now, do our best? If you shut down the phase transition engine,
the Aestivalis can't move either, you know?
It's fine, it's fine!
Have you actually thought this through!?
If we get shot down just floating around, that won't be funny!
Those people are human just like us. So it'll work out!
Minato! Please!
No idea what's up, but I'm shutting down the phase transition engine!
Captain, the enemy readings...!? Radio, infrared, gravity waves...
the enemy ship has vanished from every sensor!
Cutting even their active sensors to play dead... Well played.
Damn, they plan to let us pass right by... Cowards!
Don't panic. If their units are too quick to lock the Leap Cannon on...
...! They're using their onboard mechs...
Launch our mechs too!
Cutting all the Nadesico's power to hide is fine and all, but...
Yeah, no energy supply for the Aestivalis either. If they shoot at us...
all we can do is fire back.
Quit whining and let's do this! Those fake Gekiganger punks...
I, Gai Daigoji, will give 'em a nasty surprise!
Um, we can't move, though.
With the engines off, the enemy's sensors won't pick us up...
But if things go wrong, we'll take direct hits with no field...
Do you have any chance of winning, Captain?
...I believe in them.
Huh?
The enemy's human, right? I'll try believing in them...
Captain, what should we do?
Continue straight ahead! Stay sharp on the search!
H-How dare you... beat me up this badly!
...W-Well, fine. Next time for sure...
Butcher... You will deal with what remains... Is that clear...?
Y-Yes, sire! Without fail! Without faaail!
We did it, Kappei! ...Ah!
Oh... Uoooooh!
Waaagh! Captain...!
Vice Captain!?
Did we beat it!?
Fake Gekigan jerk! How do you like that!
Vice Captain! Saburota!
I-I'm all right, sir.
...Escaping in a lifepod now... I'd be grateful if you could pick me up...
Recover him at once! Not bad, evil Earthlings...!
We'll withdraw for now!
What!? Captain! I can still fight! If you just pick me up...!
...The difference in strength is plain to see. Besides...
Besides?
Once they saw the Leap Cannon's weakness and closed in, we'd lost.
...We'll withdraw with dignity...!
Ngh...!
They seem to have lost track of us, but...
if they keep coming this way, they'll spot us by sight, Captain.
Just sitting here waiting feels kinda...
Tch.
...Tote-chite-kenja...
Floating in space......... A mouse lost for words is simply squeak-less.
Enemy ship holding course and speed...
You can't rush it when you're fishing!
Fishing!? Give me a break!
Why not just counterattack or send a distress signal already!
The enemy aren't fish, they're people!
...Right, the enemy are people too.
So they should think things through and react sensibly.
Huh?
Nadesico, Aestivalis team, hold position.
...If we send a distress signal or start fighting...
the Elshank will be targeted by that Boson Cannon.
...If they don't know about it, they can't dodge it...!
Yurika, you... That's why!? But what about the rendezvous point!
Still no movement from the enemy. ...What could it mean?
...Enemy reinforcements?
Anti-EM particles have been dispersed, so I can't be certain, but...
there are no enemies within a 100 km radius.
Stop acceleration! We'll see what the enemy does!
Captain!?
...Probably, no, definitely, they've set a trap.
...Get cocky and you'll get burned, y'know?
(Somethin' don't add up...
No backup's comin', and they can't ambush with that firepower... So?)
Captain, huge energy reading at the planned rendezvous point.
The Elshank...! I see, the microworm drive...!
Here we go...!
Captain! Enemy ship detected!
What!?
Where are we!?
The Nadesico's signal!? And these guys... the Jovian Alliance...!
Did the Nadesico... get taken out!? Uchuta! Keiko! We're going!
That's... an Earth unit! How did they get here!?
Blast...! The enemy has a ship that can jump in a different way than ours!
Start the phase transition engine!
Prepare to launch! Mike, Lenny!
Distortion Field to maximum output!
That many enemies...!? We need to sortie now!
Gravity wave beams, make contact with each Aestivalis!
Leave it to meee!
Roger.
Princess! It's the Nadesico's signal!
I see, to hide our rendezvous from them. All right, we're moving out.
From the start, their aim was to have reinforcements that can jump
run headlong into us! At this range, we can't use the Leap Cannon...!
All right! Aestivalis team, all units follow me!
Here I gooo!
Gooo!!
I've been waiting for this!
This is Akatsuki. Nadesico, respond! It's a big catch today.
I repeat, it's a big catch today!
Ngh! I'm borrowing the Denjiiin!
Come on! The Denjin is your opponent!
Now it's Riku-Ganger...?
Don't you dare pass yourselves off as Gekiganger, you creeps!
Big and useless...
Being big isn't everything, y'know!
Enemy approaching from the Nadesico's rear.
Ho-ho-ho-hooo! How kind of you to come all the way out here to us.
Saves me the trouble.
That's... the Gaizok!
Their battleship's as tacky as ever.
Ehh? Don't you think it's cute?
This is no time for that! They're way too close!
Ho-ho-ho-hooo! Seems even Earth has someone with good taste.
Not that it changes the fact I'll kill you all. Hoh-ho-ho!
That laugh is so creepy...
Cover the Nadesico!
You wiped out Kappei's ancestral planet, and now you're after Earth...
but we won't let you have your way so easily!
That's right! Today's your last day! Prepare yourself!
Hohoho~ I'll throw those very words right back at you~!
Captain, what's that!?
...Hmph, so that's the outfit they call the Gaizok!
What's this, someone got here first? Don't get in my way!
(Now that it's become such a melee, the Leap Cannon is hardly effective.
...Chase two hares, catch no bees... the fisherman's son is a frog...
It'd be wiser not to get involved here.)
Nngh...! We can't hold out any longer!
Captain! At this point, even a suicide charge...!
...Two enemy ships, and we're nearly sunk... Downing one means nothing.
Besides...
Besides?
Once they saw the Leap Cannon's weakness and closed in, we'd lost.
...We'll withdraw with dignity...!
Ngh...!
Admirable, for an enemy. ...Send them a message.
Admirable, for an enemy. ...Send them a message.
What the? It's down to just a head!
...Did it break apart?
No... it just separated...!
Only the body ran away?
...That definitely looks like a retreat. Is that the main body!?
Like a lizard dropping its tail, huh! Kappei!
You're not getting away!
Halt! I won't let you give chase!
Don't get in my way when you're nothing but a head!
You'd run off and abandon our duel!? You coward!
Whaaat!? Who're you calling a runner!?
Kappei, don't fall for such a cheap provocation!
That battleship's body... is that really the main part?
The man with the weird laugh seems to be riding in this head here...
Shall we... pursue it?
...If this is a trap, splitting the team would be fatal.
For now, focus on wiping out the enemies here!
Captain Burning is right. Our radar is tracking the body's position.
It should be easy enough to pursue.
Kappei, let's beat Butcher first, then go after the Bandock.
...Fine. Runnin' from a fight would shame the Jin family name...
Let's settle this, Butcher!
That's more like it! Hoh-ho-ho-ho!
Did we get him!?
There was no time to escape...! We won.
All right! Next, let's neatly finish off that runaway body too...
Hey, look at that...!
Hm, what's up...? Whoa!
...Ugh... Heh, heh heh heh heh...
Butcher's still alive...
I see... he's...
A cyborg... isn't he...
Butcher, the fight's over...!
If you're the enemy's leader, then face your end like one!
Fu, fuhahaha... I was ready for that long ago!
...But there's one thing I want to ask...!
...? What!
...Why did you... For what purpose did you fight me...!?
What's that bastard getting at?
It doesn't seem like... sour grapes...
For what...? To protect peace on Earth, obviously!
Hmph...! And who... asked you to do that?
Nobody asked! It's our own choice!
...And who out there... will thank you for it?
...Who on Earth is grateful? Who... will be happy for you?
(...Captain Quattro?)
Shut up! Quit yammering!
...Earth is where we were born and raised!
I won't let anyone... anyone trash it!
We don't fight because we want something in return.
Everyone's fighting to protect their home and the places they cherish...
I won't let you call that meaningless...!
That's right, what would someone like you know!
Heh... heh heh heh... If only those who think so... lived on that planet...
then they might never... appear again...
"They"...?
Ho... Hoho... Ho... Either way... Earth is doomed to perish... doomed!
Fuhohohoho... Hahahahaha... Ha!
Did we win...?
Hard to say... It leaves a bad taste... but we did win, it seems.
A fight... someone will be happy about...?
There's no such thing. We fight to end the fighting...
There's no joy or gratitude in that. ...Only sorrow, perhaps.
(The meaning... of fighting...)
...So in the end, it just goes around in circles?
Tch, he was just messing with our heads. Fighting's our only option.
As long as they keep attacking, anyway!
...If you can't draw the line like that, you couldn't fight at all.
Captain, look...
What is it, Ruri...?
Huge energy reading from that battleship's body.
It's speeding up. At this rate, it'll leave our operational range.
Like hell we'll let it get away! We're going after the body!
Yeah! No way we're ending it on such a lousy note!
Wait! You three, don't act on your own...!
We'll stay in touch!
...You must not!
Princess... Romina?
Princess Romina raising her voice...
I understand how you Jins feel, but...
if each of us acts on our own, surviving the battles ahead
will surely be difficult, will it not...?
Ugh...
The haniwa body... is leaving radar range.
...If you chase it now, we'll lose track of you along with it.
Please, calm yourselves here... I...
it pains me to see those who fought beside me put themselves in danger...
Princess Romina...
Kappei, let's help everyone.
Damn it... Fine!
(Princess Romina... When it counts, her royal dignity really shows.
Still, the Gaizok... Behind that robot called Butcher,
is there something more...?)
Have all the Gaizok forces withdrawn!?
Looks like it's over... No readings.
Finally over, huh.
Hey, aren't we gonna chase that body?
We're not ignoring it.
But it'll have to wait until we've dealt with our current problems.
Tch! Lucky bastard...
The Gaizok concern me, but...
the Jovian Alliance's attacks are getting hard to ignore too...
True... If ships like that came in force, could we hold them off...?
Nah, no matter how strong a weapon is, it doesn't matter if you dodge it.
Against Boson Cannons... the Aestivalis will have a hard time...
Right. Without a frame that can operate independently, it'll be tough.
Who cares about the details?
Anyway, we met up with the Nadesico and beat that cocky Gaizok guy.
All's well that ends well.
And so the Mobile Battleship Nadesico joins Londo Bell once again!
It's good we joined up, but...
later you'll be telling me why you jumped to Mars on your own.
Though the Nadesico's navigation logs would tell us most of it.
Ugh... Oh well, guess I got a little too hasty.
Forgetting the Elshank could use worm navigation was a mistake.
What are you saying!
This operation worked precisely because of worm navigation!
Lady Yurika.
I'm sorry, Princess Romina! For kind of tricking you...
Tch, using us to ram into the enemy... pretty clever.
Joe, don't say that. ...The Nadesico can apparently do the same,
so next time, we can simply have the Nadesico do it.
(S-Surprisingly, maybe she holds a grudge...?)
Even so, the Meganoids, the Jovian Alliance, and even the Gaizok...
Indeed... Mars has more hostile forces than we thought...
It may be best to simply come clean with Londo Bell.
Right, right, honesty is best!
You're way too honest...
Idiot...
(The Gaizok... An evil star... They've appeared again...?)
Oh, Captain. Incoming message from the enemy ship.
Huh? What?
"My respects for your brave and bold command. That even the vile
Earth Federation Forces had so fine a young man as you was a surprise.
We shall surely meet again in battle. Genpachiro Akiyama, Kannazuki."
...End of message.
Hmph! What do you mean, "fine young man"!?
I'm such a cute girl, thank you very much!
